caption: The drawing features a single object: a long, green overcoat with full-length sleeves and a high, rounded collar. The coat is predominantly a solid green color, with vertically lined textures and shading indicating folds and the fall of the fabric. Down the front, along the hem, around the cuffs, and at the edges of the collar and cape, there are darker green, possibly fur-like trim accents that add detail and contrast to the garment. The coat also includes a matching green shoulder cape that extends to the elbows and is attached at the collar, creating an additional layer over the shoulders and upper arms. The background is plain, light beige with subtle shading, and there are no additional objects or details present aside from the signature "Mina Greene" in the lower right corner.
title: Woman's Coat
